verdict:
One hundred eighty odd repos and the intern still builds like a senate that passes a new committee every time a problem shows up. This week alone brought a food delivery app that is a find and replace of the field log, with the old README and changelog still inside, plus a pile of step shell scripts committed to its root like receipts from a bad night. There is a separate repo for every kiosk, locker, and badge idea, a dated scaffold repo every day for the testbed, and three or four synth toys that differ by paint. That is a bailout of the same idea wearing a new hat each week.

Merge these: delivery-twin, field-twin, field-twin-viridian, field-twin-violet-api, and chassisquiver into one field app family with a mode switch, since delivery-twin is already a copy. pajamastan, pajamastan-invoices, pajamastan-warrants, and pajamastan-badge-tool into one micronation office with tabs. topo-war, topo-wars, and tower2 into their current versions. topdown-pixeltown and topdown-pixeltowns into one. scope-listener, phasewell-scope, and song-offset-listener into one listener. synth, axiom, tinewood-keys, ether-wand, and bitfield-synth into one instrument shelf. looper, tapperator, stompbox-lab, hoofer-sync, and rainbow-run into one band room. The dated orange scaffold repos and the agent repos into one testbed monorepo. mill-ionaire and mail-ionaire into one shop tycoon with a mode switch.

Kill or finish these: drivethru-sim has no commits since April, and xxxx and choreography-synchronizer have no description and no excuse. x, rat, and skwiggle-v105 look abandoned. purple-vault, blue-agent-sandbox, and 2026-10-22-orange-agent are scaffolding around an experiment, so finish it or delete it. 2026-11-09-orange-lockermap is an empty repo that returns an error from the commits API, so push something or bin it. hire-portal and 2026-11-04-orange-hush have thin descriptions, so say what they are.

Keep and polish these: kat-chat, which is busy and actually shipping. groundcore and mission-operator-next, which are one of a kind. downfree-foundry, which gets real features daily even if the commits are fat. city-seek and spyhunt with its server, which are a real game. The access terminal apps stay separate on purpose, so leave them alone.
